purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence and executed public requests.
name: Busto Arsizio

queries.query: Busto Arsizio official cadastral map parcels geoportale catasto
queries.result: Search identified the official Comune di Busto Arsizio Catasto e urbanistica page, the municipal Carta tecnica comunale page, and the Agenzia delle Entrate Geoportale Cartografico Catastale.

queries.query: Busto Arsizio sito ufficiale mappa catastale particelle
queries.result: Search identified the Comune catasto/urbanistica service page and official urbanistic-attestation guidance referring to exact cadastral parcel identification; the national Agenzia delle Entrate cadastral WMS was reachable anonymously.

officialSources.observation: First-party municipal category documents catasto and urbanistica services, including CDU and access-to-records procedures. This is local procedural/custody evidence, not an anonymous parcel geometry API.
The municipal procedure requires exact identification of the cadastral parcel (mappale) for urbanistic attestations. No owner or unsafe fields were requested.

Anonymous WMS capabilities identify Cartografia Catastale and the CP.CadastralParcel (Particelle) layer, with EPSG:6706 and other CRS declarations. WMS is image/GetFeatureInfo oriented; no parcel polygon geometry endpoint was exposed by the inspected route.

requests.outcome: TLS-verified anonymous request returned HTTP 200 HTML. The current JavaScript/configuration referenced map/config-viewer.xml and enabled the catalog map viewer; no Busto-specific parcel feature API was exposed in the returned page.
Request followed a redirect/login-wall path and did not provide a usable public capability response; no login attempted.

TLS-verified anonymous request returned HTTP 200 XML capabilities. CP.CadastralParcel / Particelle was present; schema metadata listed safe parcel display fields but not a geometry feature-download route.
Anonymous request returned an XML SOAP fault/internal client error; no WFS capability or geometry response.

TLS-verified anonymous bounded GetFeatureInfo returned HTTP 200 HTML for the parcel layer. It reported one safe native INSPIRE identity, label, and NationalCadastralReference (localId IT.AGE.PLA.E514_000500.506; label 506; reference E514_000500.506). It did not return polygon geometry, and the pixel query is not treated as an exact-point hit or citywide coverage proof.
Official municipal page was readable and identifies public Carta Tecnica Comunale cartographic documents handled by Urbanistica - Espropri - SIT; no parcel API or geometry response was exposed.

registryBasis: First-party Comune di Busto Arsizio cadastral/urbanistic procedures establish a local municipal cadastral/urbanistic custodian, while Agenzia delle Entrate first-party WMS capabilities and bounded GetFeatureInfo establish a national cadastral map service with a safe native parcel identity response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Comune di Busto Arsizio municipal cadastral/urbanistic procedures plus Agenzia delle Entrate national cadastral WMS.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A bounded anonymous WMS GetFeatureInfo response was observed, but Busto citywide coverage, stable identity semantics beyond the returned fields, current data vintage, and polygon retrieval remain unverified.

pointBasis: Exact WUP queue point preserved; no coordinate shift and no exact-point hit/miss inference.
crs: EPSG:6706 declared by WMS capabilities; no geometry response retrieved.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No polygon geometry was returned; the bounded GetFeatureInfo response is not used as an exact-point or citywide hit claim.
requestEvidence: WMS GetFeatureInfo: HTTP 200 safe ID/label/reference HTML
WFS capability attempt: XML SOAP fault

uncertainty: The official WMS is reachable anonymously and returned a safe parcel identity for a bounded map query, but the current public route exposes no retained polygon geometry, anonymous citywide extraction behavior, or independently qualified runtime adapter. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
